request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Lanterncap Toad".

Creative brief
Name: Lanterncap Toad
Collection: Briarwild Brood. Woodland animals reshaped by an ancient living forest, using thorns, seeds, roots, sap, and leaf-pattern projectiles.
Core concept: A stationary area-denial caster that grows explosive seed pods.
Body and silhouette: Broad squat toad with short legs, a wide mouth, and a large mushroom cap growing from its back.
Signature features: Glowing cap spots, swollen throat pouch, and three seed bulbs around the shoulders.
Palette and materials: Muddy olive, mushroom red, warm amber, and pale fungal cream.
Movement personality: Patient, heavy, and suddenly spring-loaded.
Attack concept: Inflates its throat before lobbing a glowing seed that lands visibly, pauses, and bursts into six evenly spaced spores.
Directional details: One small mushroom grows only beside the left eye.
Avoid: Poison-dart-frog colors, realistic slime, oversized boss proportions.
